visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-angle close-up of a CoDrone, a compact black quadcopter featuring protective frames around four propellers, resting on a white flat surface. A brand logo "codrone" is displayed in the bottom-left corner. The camera then cuts to a blue electronic controller board equipped with two black joysticks and various colored connecting wires. (2) Inside a bright, minimalist room, the drone is seen hovering steadily at eye-level. Large white text reading "CODE IT" appears as the scene transitions to a man in a business suit working on a laptop. Following this, a young boy with glasses is shown in a tech laboratory environment, focused on a monitor and typing on a keyboard. (3) The setting shifts outdoors where "FLY IT" text is overlaid. The drone performs various aerial maneuvers over a brick-paved courtyard near trees and buildings under bright daylight. Graphical annotations appear, labeling advanced features such as "Pattern Flying," where yellow lines trace its path, "Motion Tracking" using hand gestures, and "Auto Hovering" stability. (4) A top-down shot features the text "TRANSFORM IT." The quadcopter's arms fold inward in a stop-motion sequence, and three large black wheels are attached to the body. This new robot vehicle, featuring glowing blue LED "eyes," is shown driving across a white tiled floor and rolling through a carpeted corridor. (5) Footage from a tech convention shows a booth for "ROBOLINK" with a crowd and a "Kickstarter" poster. A young boy in a green hoodie is shown using a controller and laptop to pilot the drone. The video concludes on a clean white screen displaying the "codrone" logo and the phrase "Code and Play."
